annotation.title_clean: Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial Uruguay 2024 – 2030
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of Uruguay 2024–2030
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agesic (Agencia de Gobierno Electrónico y Sociedad de la Información y del Conocimiento), Uruguay
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Uruguay's national AI strategy 2024–2030, led by Agesic with CAF and UNESCO. It sets ten guiding principles aligned with UNESCO, OECD and Council of Europe instruments, and three axes (governance, capabilities, sustainable development). It plans risk-based regulation, sandboxes, an AI observatory and capacity building. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten guiding principles including human rights, non-discrimination, transparency, accountability and reliability; they create no new legal obligations
Develop risk-based regulatory frameworks and assess prohibitions or moratoria for unacceptable AI applications
Consolidate the State AI Observatory and set up institutional governance model
Promote regulatory sandboxes, public procurement policy and audit models
Roadmap with indicators and semiannual public monitoring; valid 2024-2030 with mid-term review
